sensor: Thermal: vanadium oxide uncooled focal plane array, 384x288, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 25 mK; optical: 1/1.8in CMOS, 4 MP

storage.notes: microSD/SDHC/SDXC up to 256 GB; NAS (NFS, SMB/CIFS); ANR

features: Thermal TandemVu: bi-spectrum bullet (thermal + optical) plus integrated optical PTZ speed dome
Thermal detector: uncooled VOx, 384x288, 12 um pixel pitch, NETD < 25 mK
Thermal lens 25 mm fixed, F1.0, FOV 11.2 by 8.6
Optical bullet channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 12.4 mm lens
Integrated optical PTZ speed dome: 4 MP, 6-240 mm 40x optical zoom, smart auto-tracking of moving targets
White light supplement up to 250 m
Perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit (up to 8 VCA rules)
One-touch click linkage / auto-calibration between bullet and PTZ
Built-in speaker for audible alarm, whitelight LED supplement
Thermal DORI (humans 1.8 x 0.5 m): detection 1042 m, recognition 260 m, identification 130 m
VCA range: 750 m for vehicles, 250 m for humans

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical bullet, thermal, and optical PTZ dome are exposed as separate channels.

release_notes: HikMicro TandemVu unit combining a 384x288 thermal + 4 MP optical bi-spectrum bullet for perimeter protection with a 4 MP 40x optical PTZ dome that smart-tracks moving targets. The -25 carries a 25 mm long-range thermal lens.
